name: Old Quarter
subtitle: Every empire starts on a side street.
description: Rain-dark alleys, family shops and favors older than the city. Small jobs earn a name here; debts keep it.

name: Portside
subtitle: The tide brings money and trouble.
description: Freighters crowd the horizon. Dock crews trade loyalty as carefully as cargo, and every arrival changes the balance.

name: The Strip
subtitle: A bright room can hide a dark bargain.
description: Clubs, private tables and immaculate strangers. Reputation opens doors that money alone cannot buy.

name: Ironworks
subtitle: Power is built under pressure.
description: Silent factories and stubborn crews sit between old industry and new ambition. Influence carries more weight than charm.

name: Crown Heights
subtitle: The skyline belongs to someone.
description: Private towers overlook everything you have fought for. A seat at the top costs more than cash.
